findings.desc: experiments/recovery-runner/run-driver.mjs:419 and experiments/recovery-runner/parameterized-fault-profile.mjs:81-88: a dangling explicit --scenarioProfile flag fail-opens to the fixed default instead of exiting 2. Repro: tmp=$(mktemp -d) && node experiments/recovery-runner/run-driver.mjs --record "$tmp/missing.jsonl" --tasks foo --k 1 --scenarioProfile; observed exit 0, 77 cells enumerated, and an exclusions sidecar written. Because arg() returns undefined for a missing flag value and parseScenarioProfile treats null/undefined profile+params as no flags, malformed profile input is accepted silently, violating the storys fail-closed profile validation contract and potentially running the wrong campaign if --engine is also supplied.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by commit 90de58a81af05f444d6fa8c27330f226fd0ca8d5. run-driver now detects present flags with missing values before profile parsing, so dangling --scenarioProfile exits 2 before records/sidecars. Verified original repro exits 2 with no sidecars, dangling --scenarioParams exits 2 with no sidecars, --scenarioProfile weighted without params exits 2 with no sidecars, valid weighted profile still prints B1,B1,B2, git diff --check passes, and run-driver-selfcheck reports 167 assertions passed.
